title: A Mathematician's Lament (2002) [pdf]
summary: Paul Lockhart's influential 2002 essay critiquing K-12 mathematics education, arguing that math is taught as a mechanical, rule-following exercise rather than a creative art form, and advocating for inquiry-based, artistically-inspired approaches to mathematics instruction.
problem_solved: Addresses the fundamental problem of mathematics being poorly taught as disconnected formulas and procedures instead of creative exploration.
why_valuable: Provides a passionate, articulate critique that has sparked important conversations about mathematics education reform and inspired alternative pedagogical approaches.
